items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1960-03-16
items.q: I went to work as a bellhop for Frederick Grouse.

ctx.x: Were you born up that way?

I was born in Charity Hospital, and I was raised up on Ramport between Gerard and Julia. And we left from there, we moved to Perdita Street between Liberty and Howard. And from there we moved up to Carlton, and back down to the old Tenderline District a few years before they closed it up. Well I went to work around there when I was 13 years old, and Henry Martin was playing drums at Rice Cafe, right at the corner of Iberville and Murray. Right across the street from Pete Lollers. Well I don't know what band they…
Where was this place, what was it, the saloon?
